note: Personnel listing 1985-86, two columns flattened; page image rendered and read to assign titles (printed BELOW each name's bio block) and columns. Headings by page image: line 9 SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS; 18 CLERICAL STAFF/HIGH SCHOOL (right col); 19 CLERICAL STAFF/CENTRAL ADMINISTRATION (left col, same line as Ayles' name); 58 ADMINISTRATION/MIDDLE SCHOOL; 69 ADMINISTRATION/HIGH SCHOOL (same line as Bourque's name). School decided by those headings: central-office for the Superintendent and Central Administration clerical staff; high for Clerical Staff/High School and Administration/High School; turkey-hill for Administration/Middle School. Page school is central-office (first entry on the left column is the Superintendent, Allard) though the right column opens with Dennis G. Keeney, whose heading (a prior page) is not on this page: his printed title is Administrative Coordinator to the High School Principal, so school high and dept ''. Cynthia Romano is listed twice (line with HS registrar entry, and again under Central Administration as Senior Clerk/Typist). Welch (retired eff. 2/28/86) and MacKenzie (resigned eff. 2/21/86) are printed in the 1985-86 listing with those dates; kept as listed (MacKenzie's entry, line 41, carries the Superintendent's Secretary title, which her listing prints below 'replacing Virginia Welch'). All education/degree/began/FTE detail lines and the page number (line 91) are ignored; lines holding only titles continuation or bio are ignored.
